purpose: WOT High-RPM Power Spark Advance & Decel Overrun Restoration

tune.status: Candidate prepared and verified in VCM Editor; ready for owner flash

changes_since_previous_run: Derived from paired v032 WOT drive logs: (1) Advances [ECM] 44583 Spark Borderline Knock table across 5,000-7,200 RPM in Row 8 (13.50 deg at 5k, 14.00 deg at 5.75k-7.2k) and Row 9 (12.50 deg at 5k, 13.00 deg at 5.75k-7.2k), eliminating high-RPM timing droop and maximizing WOT pull strength to redline; (2) Keeps rich WOT fuel safety margin (~10.5-10.8 AFR); (3) Inherits full v033 loud crisp decel pop package (ECM 44496 DFCO delay = 1.40s, ECM 44605 = 2 deg at 2k, -8 deg at 3k, -10 deg at 4k-6k) and v032 anti-shuffle fixes.

profile.status: All 18 requested channels required; paired with SCG-1 wideband lambda

conditions.accessories: Standard driving; A/C OFF during pulls

stop_conditions: Wideband lambda > 0.80 (> 11.7 AFR) under boost > 8 psi
Boost spike > 15.5 psi (approaching 16 psi SCG-1 cut)
Engine stall or severe undershoot (< 700 RPM) on clutch-in
